Ternary Search Peak in Unimodal Array
10
Easy
Problem Statement:
Write a program to find the index of the maximum element in a unimodal array using ternary search. A unimodal array is one that increases and then decreases. Find the peak element efficiently. 
Input Description:
First line: Unimodal array elements separated by space. 
Output Description:
Index of the maximum element. 
Sample Input:
1 3 7 9 8 5 2 
Sample Output:
3
